        "contents": "export class AgentOrchestrator {\nprivate getProvider(llmConfig: LLMConfig): ILLMProvider {\n\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 保存消息历史\n   */\n  private async saveMessages(\n    conversationId: string,\n    userQuery: string,\n    response: LLMResponse,\n    roleId: string,\n    toolCalls?: Array&lt;{ toolName: string; status: string; error?: string }&gt;\n  ): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n    try {\n      // 创建或更新对话会话\n      await ChatMessageService.upsertConversation({\n        conversation_id: conversationId,\n        app_type: 'direct-agent',\n        session_name: userQuery.substring(0, 50) + (userQuery.length &gt; 50 ? '...' : ''),\n        status: 'active'\n      });\n\n      // 保存用户消息\n      const userMessageId = &#96;user_${Date.now()}_${uuidv4()}&#96;;\n      await ChatMessageService.saveChatMessage({\n        message_id: userMessageId,\n        conversation_id: conversationId,\n        message_type: 'user',\n        content: userQuery,\n        query: userQuery,\n        app_type: 'direct-agent',\n        status: 'completed'\n      });\n\n      // 保存助手回复\n      const assistantMessageId = &#96;assistant_${Date.now()}_${uuidv4()}&#96;;\n      await ChatMessageService.saveChatMessage({\n        message_id: assistantMessageId,\n        conversation_id: conversationId,\n        message_type: 'assistant',\n        content: response.content,\n        app_type: 'direct-agent',\n        prompt_tokens: response.usage.promptTokens,\n        completion_tokens: response.usage.completionTokens,\n        total_tokens: response.usage.totalTokens,\n        status: 'completed'\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('保存消息历史失败:', error);\n      // 不抛出错误，避免影响主流程\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 生成对话ID\n   */\n  private generateConversationId(): string {\n    return &#96;conv-${Date.now()}-${uuidv4()}&#96;;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class WorkflowExecutionModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 创建执行实例（支持Agent工作流和Dify工作流）\n   */\n  async create(data: CreateWorkflowExecutionDTO): Promise&lt;WorkflowExecution&gt; {\n    await this.ensureConnection();\n\n    const id = data.id || &#96;exec_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(7)}&#96;;\n    const status = data.status || 'pending';\n    const executionType = data.execution_type;\n\n    const sql = &#96;\n      INSERT INTO workflow_executions (\n        id, execution_type, workflow_id, workflow_name, shared_context, node_results,\n        workflow_run_id, task_id, message_id, app_type,\n        status, error_message, inputs, outputs,\n        elapsed_time, total_tokens, total_steps, duration,\n        start_time, end_time, started_at, finished_at,\n        created_at, updated_at\n      ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)\n    &#96;;\n\n    const params = [\n      id,\n      executionType,\n      // Agent工作流字段\n      data.workflow_id || null,\n      data.workflow_name || null,\n      data.shared_context ? JSON.stringify(data.shared_context) : null,\n      data.node_results ? JSON.stringify(data.node_results) : null,\n      // Dify工作流字段\n      data.workflow_run_id || null,\n      data.task_id || null,\n      data.message_id || null,\n      data.app_type || null,\n      // 通用字段\n      status,\n      data.error_message || null,\n      data.inputs ? JSON.stringify(data.inputs) : null,\n      data.outputs ? JSON.stringify(data.outputs) : null,\n      data.elapsed_time || null,\n      data.total_tokens || null,\n      data.total_steps || null,\n      data.duration || null,\n      // 时间戳\n      data.start_time || null,\n      data.end_time || null,\n      data.started_at || null,\n      data.finished_at || null,\n    ];\n\n    await this.db.query(sql, params);\n\n    return await this.getById(id) as WorkflowExecution;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 根据ID获取执行实例\n   */\n  async getById(id: string): Promise&lt;WorkflowExecution | null&gt; {\n    await this.ensureConnection();\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * AI问答服务\n */\nexport class AiSearchService {\n  /**\n   * 初始化数据库表\n   */\n  async initializeTables(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n    try {\n      // 创建AI问答对话表\n      await db.query(&#96;\n        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ai_search_conversations (\n          id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n          title TEXT NOT NULL,\n          sources TEXT NOT NULL,\n          page_type TEXT,\n          created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n          updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n        )\n      &#96;);\n      \n      // 如果表已存在但没有 page_type 字段，添加该字段\n      try {\n        await db.query(&#96;ALTER TABLE ai_search_conversations ADD COLUMN page_type TEXT&#96;);\n      } catch (error: any) {\n        // 如果字段已存在，忽略错误\n        if (!error?.message?.includes('duplicate column') &amp;&amp; !error?.message?.includes('already exists')) {\n          logger.warn('添加 page_type 字段失败（可能已存在）', { error });\n        }\n      }\n\n      // 如果表已存在但没有 dify_conversation_id 字段，添加该字段\n      try {\n        await db.query(&#96;ALTER TABLE ai_search_conversations ADD COLUMN dify_conversation_id TEXT&#96;);\n      } catch (error: any) {\n        // 如果字段已存在，忽略错误\n        if (!error?.message?.includes('duplicate column') &amp;&amp; !error?.message?.includes('already exists')) {\n          logger.warn('添加 dify_conversation_id 字段失败（可能已存在）', { error });\n        }\n      }\n\n      // 创建AI问答消息表\n      await db.query(&#96;\n        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ai_search_messages (\n          id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n          conversation_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n          role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('user', 'assistant')),\n          content TEXT NOT NULL,\n          sources TEXT,\n          outputs TEXT,\n          created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n          FOREIGN KEY (conversation_id) REFERENCES ai_search_conversations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n        )\n      &#96;);\n\n      // 创建输出内容表\n      await\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "-- 头脑风暴群聊功能数据库表结构\n-- 用于存储多Agent协作讨论的会话、参与者和消息\n\n-- 1. 头脑风暴会话表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS brainstorm_sessions (\n    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n    title TEXT NOT NULL,\n    topic TEXT NOT NULL,\n    description TEXT,\n    creator_id TEXT,\n    project_id INTEGER, -- 关联的项目ID\n    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'active', 'completed', 'stopped')),\n    config TEXT, -- JSON格式存储配置（终止条件等）\n    summary TEXT, -- AI生成的讨论总结\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    completed_at DATETIME\n);\n\n-- 2. 参与者表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS brainstorm_participants (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    session_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n    ai_role_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n    display_name TEXT,\n    role_type TEXT, -- 角色类型（专家领域）\n    sort_order INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES brainstorm_sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n);\n\n-- 3. 讨论消息表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS brainstorm_messages (\n    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n    session_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n    participant_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    round_number INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\n    content TEXT NOT NULL,\n    reply_to_id TEXT, -- 回复的消息ID（可选）\n    metadata TEXT, -- JSON格式存储元数据（token使用等）\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES brainstorm_sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (participant_id) REFERENCES brainstorm_participants(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (reply_to_id) REFERENCES brainstorm_messages(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\n);\n\n-- 创建索引以提高查询性能\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_brainstorm_sessions_status ON brainstorm_sessions(status);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_brainstorm_sessions_created_at ON brainstorm_sessions(created_at DESC);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_brainstorm_sessions_creator_id ON brainstorm_sessions(creator_id);",

        "contents": "- [ ] 配置技术通稿生成完整流程\n- [ ] 配置技术发布会稿生成流程\n- [ ] 前端集成完整流程UI\n- [ ] 性能和成本优化\n\n**验收标准**：\n\n- 3个核心场景完整可用\n- 端到端成功率&gt;90%\n- 用户满意度&gt;85%\n\n**业务价值**：\n\n- 完整的产品化能力\n- 可量化的业务价值\n\n---\n\n## 四、技术架构细化\n\n### 4.1 数据库扩展\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n-- 需求澄清记录表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS requirement_clarifications (\n    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n    user_question TEXT NOT NULL,\n    completeness_score REAL,\n    missing_info TEXT,              -- JSON数组\n    clarification_qa TEXT,          -- JSON对象，问答对\n    structured_requirement TEXT,    -- JSON对象\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 知识库文档表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_documents (\n    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n    project_id TEXT,\n    title TEXT NOT NULL,\n    content TEXT NOT NULL,\n    embedding BLOB,                 -- 向量嵌入\n    metadata TEXT,                  -- JSON\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- RAG检索记录表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS rag_retrievals (\n    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n    query TEXT NOT NULL,\n    project_id TEXT,\n    retrieved_docs TEXT,            -- JSON数组\n    context_used TEXT,\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 质量评估记录表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS quality_evaluations (\n    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n    execution_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n    iteration INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    content TEXT NOT NULL,\n    overall_score REAL,\n    dimension_scores TEXT,          -- JSON对象\n    feedback TEXT,\n    pass_threshold INTEGER,         -- 0或1\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    \n    FOREIGN KEY (execution_id) REFERENCES multi_agent_executions(id)\n);\n\nCREATE INDEX idx_knowledge_project ON knowledge_documents(project_id);\nCREATE INDEX idx_rag_query ON rag_retrievals(query);\nCREATE INDEX idx_quality_execution ON quality_evaluations(execution_id);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;",

## 备份文件大的原因

### 主要原因：`ai_search_conversations` 表数据量大

- 记录数：296,289 条（近30万条）
- sources 字段总大小：340.89 MB
- 平均每条记录的 sources 字段：约 1.2 KB
- 时间范围：2025-11-27 至 2026-01-13（约48天）
- 平均每天产生：约 6,172 条记录

### 数据库空间分布

| 项目 | 大小 |
|------|------|
| **ai_search_conversations.sources** | 340.89 MB |
| 其他表数据 | ~1 MB |
| 索引（202个） | ~580 MB |
| **总计** | **~922 MB** |

### 问题分析

1. 数据积累：近30万条 AI 搜索对话记录，每条包含 JSON 格式的 sources（来源信息）
2. 索引占用：202 个索引占用约 580 MB
3. 无数据清理策略：历史记录未清理，持续增长

### 建议解决方案

1. 清理旧数据：删除超过一定时间（如90天）的历史记录
2. 数据归档：将旧数据导出到归档表或文件
3. 定期维护：定期执行 VACUUM 优化数据库
4. 压缩存储：如果 sources 字段可以压缩，考虑压缩存储

        "contents": "| start_time | TIMESTAMP | 开始时间 |\n| end_time | TIMESTAMP | 结束时间 |\n| started_at | DATETIME | 开始时间（Dify工作流） |\n| finished_at | DATETIME | 完成时间（Dify工作流） |\n| created_at | TIMESTAMP | 创建时间 |\n| updated_at | TIMESTAMP | 更新时间 |\n\n#### 2.4.3 对话会话表 (conversations)\n\n存储对话会话信息。\n\n#### 2.4.4 聊天消息表 (chat_messages)\n\n存储聊天消息，关联对话会话。\n\n### 2.5 第五层：配置与统计层\n\n#### 2.5.1 AI角色表 (ai_roles)\n\n存储AI角色配置。\n\n| 字段名 | 类型 | 说明 |\n|--------|------|------|\n| id | TEXT | 主键 |\n| name | TEXT | 角色名称 |\n| description | TEXT | 描述 |\n| avatar | TEXT | 头像URL |\n| system_prompt | TEXT | 系统提示词 |\n| dify_config | TEXT | JSON字符串，Dify配置 |\n| enabled | INTEGER | 是否启用（0/1） |\n| source | TEXT | 来源标记 |\n| created_at | TIMESTAMP | 创建时间 |\n| updated_at | TIMESTAMP | 更新时间 |\n\n**dify_config JSON结构**：\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"apiUrl\": \"string\",\n  \"apiKey\": \"string\",\n  \"connectionType\": \"chatflow\" | \"workflow\",\n  \"inputFields\": [...]\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### 2.5.2 公开页面配置表 (public_page_configs)\n\n存储公开页面配置。\n\n#### 2.5.3 页面工具配置表 (page_tool_configs)\n\n存储页面工具配置，按页面类型唯一。\n\n#### 2.5.4 文件表 (files)\n\n存储上传的文件信息。\n\n#### 2.5.5 统计表\n\n- **workflow_node_usage** - 工作流节点使用统计\n- **ai_qa_feedback** - AI问答评价统计\n- **workflow_session_stats** - 工作流会话统计\n- **node_content_processing** - 节点内容处理统计\n- **workflow_stats_summary** - 实时统计汇总\n\n## 三、关键设计决策\n\n### 3.1 workflow_executions表统一\n\n**问题**：原有两个不同的&#96;workflow_executions&#96;表定义：\n1. Agent工作流执行表（TEXT主键，包含shared_context、node_results等）\n2. Dify工作流执行表（INTEGER主键，包含workflow_run_id、task_id等）\n\n**解决方案**：\n- 合并为统一表，使用TEXT主键\n- 添加&#96;execution_type&#96;字段区分类型",

        "contents": "-- 公开页面配置表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public_page_configs (\n    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n    name TEXT NOT NULL,\n    description TEXT,\n    address TEXT,                              -- 地址配置\n    display_mode TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'all',  -- all/workflow/custom/role\n    workflow_id TEXT,                          -- 关联的工作流ID（workflow模式）\n    role_ids TEXT,                             -- JSON字符串，角色ID列表（custom/role模式）\n    access_token TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,         -- 访问令牌，用于生成访问链接\n    is_active INTEGER DEFAULT 1,               -- 0或1，是否启用\n    template_type TEXT,                        -- 模板类型: 'speech', 'ai-chat', 'custom'\n    custom_html TEXT,                          -- 自定义HTML内容\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 页面工具配置表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS page_tool_configs (\n    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n    page_type TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,  -- 页面类型: 'tech-package', 'press-release', 'tech-strategy', 'tech-article'\n    page_title TEXT NOT NULL,         -- 页面标题\n    dialogue_title TEXT NOT NULL,     -- 对话标题\n    studio_title TEXT NOT NULL,       -- Studio侧边栏标题\n    workflow_selection_key TEXT NOT NULL,  -- 工作流选择键\n    enabled_tool_ids TEXT,            -- JSON数组，启用的工具ID列表\n    feature_label_map TEXT,           -- JSON对象，功能标签映射\n    is_active INTEGER DEFAULT 1,     -- 0或1，是否启用\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 文件存储表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS files (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,",

        "contents": "## 数据库表完整列表（20个）\n\n数据库文件: ./data/todify2.db\n\n### 核心配置表 (6个):\nagent_workflows - Agent工作流 [模型✅ 路由✅]\nai_roles - AI角色配置 [模型✅ 路由✅]\nworkflow_executions - 工作流执行记录 [模型✅ 路由✅]\nworkflow_templates - 工作流模板 [模型✅ 路由✅]\npublic_page_configs - 公开页面配置 [模型✅ 路由✅]\npage_tool_configs - 页面工具配置 [模型✅ 路由✅]\n\n\n### AI搜索相关表 (4个):\nai_search_conversations - AI搜索对话 [服务✅]\nai_search_messages - AI搜索消息 [服务✅]\nai_search_outputs - AI搜索输出 [服务✅]\nai_search_field_mappings - AI搜索字段映射 [服务✅]\n\n### 聊天对话表 (4个):\nconversations - 对话会话 [服务✅ 路由✅]\nchat_messages - 聊天消息 [服务✅ 路由✅]\nknowledge_usage_logs - 知识使用日志 [服务✅]\nworkflow_executions - 工作流执行记录 [服务✅ 路由✅] (与第3项重复)\n\n\n### 业务数据表 (5个):\nbrands - 品牌 [模型✅ 路由✅]\ncar_models - 车型 [模型✅ 路由✅]\ncar_series - 车系 [模型✅ 路由✅]\ntech_categories - 技术分类 [模型✅ 路由✅]\ntech_points - 技术点 [模型✅ 路由✅]\n\n### 文件和服务表 (2个):\nfiles - 文件存储 [服务✅]\nworkflow_stats_summary - 工作流统计 [模型✅ 路由✅]\n\n### 来源信息表 (1个):\nsource_information - 来源信息 [模型✅ 路由✅]",

        "contents": "-- AI角色相关数据库表\n\n-- 1. AI角色表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ai_roles (\n    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n    name TEXT NOT NULL,\n    description TEXT NOT NULL,\n    avatar TEXT,                     -- 角色头像URL（可选）\n    system_prompt TEXT,               -- 系统提示词（可选）\n    dify_config TEXT NOT NULL,       -- JSON字符串，存储Dify配置（apiUrl, apiKey, connectionType, inputFields）\n    enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, -- 0或1，是否启用\n    source TEXT,                     -- 来源标记：'smart-workflow', 'independent-page', 'custom'\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 创建索引\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ai_roles_name ON ai_roles(name);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ai_roles_enabled ON ai_roles(enabled);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ai_roles_source ON ai_roles(source);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ai_roles_updated ON ai_roles(updated_at DESC);\n\n-- 创建触发器，自动更新updated_at字段\nCREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS update_ai_roles_updated_at\nAFTER UPDATE ON ai_roles\nBEGIN\n    UPDATE ai_roles SET updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = NEW.id;\nEND;",

        "contents": "-- 公开页面配置表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public_page_configs (\n    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n    name TEXT NOT NULL,\n    description TEXT,\n    address TEXT,                              -- 地址配置\n    display_mode TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'all' CHECK (display_mode IN ('all', 'workflow', 'custom', 'role')),  -- all/workflow/custom/role\n    workflow_id TEXT,                          -- 关联的工作流ID（workflow模式）\n    role_ids TEXT,                             -- JSON字符串，角色ID列表（custom/role模式）\n    access_token TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,         -- 访问令牌，用于生成访问链接\n    is_active INTEGER DEFAULT 1,               -- 0或1，是否启用\n    template_type TEXT,                        -- 模板类型: 'speech', 'ai-chat', 'custom'\n    custom_html TEXT,                          -- 自定义HTML内容\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 页面工具配置表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS page_tool_configs (\n    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n    page_type TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (page_type IN ('tech-package', 'press-release', 'tech-strategy', 'tech-article')),  -- 页面类型\n    page_title TEXT NOT NULL,         -- 页面标题\n    dialogue_title TEXT NOT NULL,     -- 对话标题\n    studio_title TEXT NOT NULL,       -- Studio侧边栏标题\n    workflow_selection_key TEXT NOT NULL,  -- 工作流选择键\n    enabled_tool_ids TEXT,            -- JSON数组，启用的工具ID列表\n    feature_label_map TEXT,           -- JSON对象，功能标签映射\n    is_active INTEGER DEFAULT 1,     -- 0或1，是否启用\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 文件存储表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS files (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,",

        "contents": "-- 公开页面配置相关数据库表\n\n-- 公开页面配置表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public_page_configs (\n    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n    name TEXT NOT NULL,\n    description TEXT,\n    address TEXT,                              -- 地址配置\n    display_mode TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'all',  -- all/workflow/custom\n    workflow_id TEXT,                          -- 关联的工作流ID（workflow模式）\n    role_ids TEXT,                             -- JSON字符串，角色ID列表（custom模式）\n    access_token TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,         -- 访问令牌，用于生成访问链接\n    is_active INTEGER DEFAULT 1,               -- 0或1，是否启用\n    template_type TEXT,                        -- 模板类型: 'speech', 'ai-chat', 'custom'\n    custom_html TEXT,                          -- 自定义HTML内容\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 创建索引\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_public_page_configs_token ON public_page_configs(access_token);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_public_page_configs_active ON public_page_configs(is_active);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_public_page_configs_created ON public_page_configs(created_at DESC);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_public_page_configs_workflow ON public_page_configs(workflow_id) WHERE workflow_id IS NOT NULL;\n\n-- 创建触发器，自动更新updated_at字段\nCREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS update_public_page_configs_updated_at\nAFTER UPDATE ON public_page_configs\nBEGIN\n    UPDATE public_page_configs SET updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = NEW.id;\nEND;",

        "contents": "-- 页面工具配置相关数据库表\n-- 用于管理每个页面可用的工具列表和标签映射\n\n-- 页面工具配置表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS page_tool_configs (\n    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n    page_type TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,  -- 页面类型: 'tech-package', 'press-release', 'tech-strategy', 'tech-article'\n    page_title TEXT NOT NULL,         -- 页面标题\n    dialogue_title TEXT NOT NULL,     -- 对话标题\n    studio_title TEXT NOT NULL,       -- Studio侧边栏标题\n    workflow_selection_key TEXT NOT NULL,  -- 工作流选择键\n    enabled_tool_ids TEXT,            -- JSON数组，启用的工具ID列表\n    feature_label_map TEXT,           -- JSON对象，功能标签映射\n    is_active INTEGER DEFAULT 1,     -- 0或1，是否启用\n    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- 创建索引\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_page_tool_configs_page_type ON page_tool_configs(page_type);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_page_tool_configs_active ON page_tool_configs(is_active);\n\n-- 创建触发器，自动更新updated_at字段\nCREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS update_page_tool_configs_updated_at\nAFTER UPDATE ON page_tool_configs\nBEGIN\n    UPDATE page_tool_configs SET updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = NEW.id;\nEND;\n\n-- 插入默认配置数据（使用INSERT OR REPLACE for SQLite，或使用ON CONFLICT for PostgreSQL）\n-- SQLite版本\nINSERT OR REPLACE INTO page_tool_configs (\n    id,\n    page_type,\n    page_title,\n    dialogue_title,\n    studio_title,\n    workflow_selection_key,\n    enabled_tool_ids,\n    feature_label_map,\n    is_active\n) VALUES\n-- 技术包装页面配置\n(\n    'tech-package-default',\n    'tech-package',\n    '技术包装',",

        "contents": "│ └─────────────┘ │    │ └─────────────┘ │    │ └─────────────┘ │\n└─────────────────┘    └─────────────────┘    └─────────────────┘\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 数据库架构设计\n\n### 核心管理表\n\n#### WorkflowConfiguration 表\n\n工作流配置表，存储每个工作流的基本配置和元数据信息。\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nCREATE TABLE \"WorkflowConfiguration\" (\n    \"id\" TEXT NOT NULL,\n    \"workflowType\" TEXT NOT NULL,\n    \"name\" TEXT NOT NULL,\n    \"description\" TEXT,\n    \"version\" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '1.0.0',\n    \"difyWorkflowId\" TEXT,\n    \"isActive\" BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,\n    \"config\" JSONB NOT NULL,\n    \"metadata\" JSONB,\n    \"outputSchema\" JSONB,\n    \"validationRules\" JSONB,\n    \"uiConfiguration\" JSONB,\n    \"qualityMetrics\" JSONB,\n    \"exportOptions\" JSONB,\n    \"createdAt\" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    \"updatedAt\" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL,\n    CONSTRAINT \"WorkflowConfiguration_pkey\" PRIMARY KEY (\"id\")\n);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**字段说明：**\n- &#96;workflowType&#96;: 工作流类型（IP_MINING, TECH_ARTICLE, SPEECH_WRITING）\n- &#96;difyWorkflowId&#96;: 对应的Dify工作流ID\n- &#96;config&#96;: 工作流基本配置（超时、重试等）\n- &#96;outputSchema&#96;: 输出数据结构定义\n- &#96;validationRules&#96;: 输入验证规则\n- &#96;uiConfiguration&#96;: UI界面配置\n- &#96;qualityMetrics&#96;: 质量评估指标\n- &#96;exportOptions&#96;: 导出选项配置\n\n#### WorkflowFieldMapping 表\n\n字段映射表，管理前端字段到内部字段和Dify字段的映射关系。\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nCREATE TABLE \"WorkflowFieldMapping\" (\n    \"id\" TEXT NOT NULL,",

        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./guide/database/数据库检查与优化报告.md",

          "endPosition": {

          }
        },
        "contents": "**评价**: 多对多关系设计合理，支持复杂关联。\n\n#### ✅ 第三层：AI内容生成层（混合策略）\n\n| 表名 | 用途 | 存储策略 | 状态 |\n|------|------|----------|------|\n| &#96;knowledge_points&#96; | 知识点 | 独立表 | ✅ |\n| &#96;tech_packaging_materials&#96; | 技术包装 | JSON存储 | ⚠️ Schema存在但未使用 |\n| &#96;tech_promotion_strategies&#96; | 推广策略 | JSON存储 | ⚠️ Schema存在但未使用 |\n| &#96;tech_press_releases&#96; | 技术通稿 | JSON存储 | ⚠️ Schema存在但未使用 |\n| &#96;tech_speeches&#96; | 演讲稿 | JSON存储 | ⚠️ Schema存在但未使用 |\n\n**架构决策**: \n- ✅ **知识点表**: 需要搜索、筛选 → 独立表\n- ✅ **内容生成表**: 临时生成、立即使用 → JSON存储（workflow_executions.outputs）\n\n**建议**: \n- 保持当前JSON存储策略（符合业务需求）\n- 如果未来需要内容管理功能，再创建独立表\n\n#### ✅ 第四层：工作流与对话层（100%完整）\n\n| 表名 | 用途 | 状态 |\n|------|------|------|\n| &#96;agent_workflows&#96; | Agent工作流定义 | ✅ |\n| &#96;workflow_executions&#96; | 工作流执行记录（统一表） | ✅ |\n| &#96;workflow_templates&#96; | 工作流模板 | ✅ |\n| &#96;conversations&#96; | 对话会话 | ✅ |\n| &#96;chat_messages&#96; | 聊天消息 | ✅ |\n\n**关键设计**: &#96;workflow_executions&#96; 统一表设计优秀，通过 &#96;execution_type&#96; 区分不同类型。\n\n#### ✅ 第五层：配置与统计层（100%完整）\n\n| 表名 | 用途 | 状态 |\n|------|------|------|\n| &#96;ai_roles&#96; | AI角色配置 | ✅ |\n| &#96;public_page_configs&#96; | 公开页面配置 | ✅ |\n| &#96;page_tool_configs&#96; | 页面工具配置 | ✅ |\n| &#96;files&#96; | 文件存储 | ✅ |\n| &#96;workflow_node_usage&#96; | 节点使用统计 | ✅ |\n| &#96;ai_qa_feedback&#96; | AI问答评价 | ✅ |\n| &#96;workflow_session_stats&#96; | 会话统计 | ✅ |\n| &#96;node_content_processing&#96; | 内容处理统计 | ✅ |\n| &#96;workflow_stats_summary&#96; | 统计汇总 | ✅ |\n\n**评价**: 配置和统计表完整，支持系统可观测性。",

        "contents": "/**\n * 创建ai_roles表（如果不存在）\n */\nasync function createAIRolesTable(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n  console.log('📋 检查并创建 ai_roles 表...');\n  \n  try {\n    // 检查表是否存在\n    const checkTableSql = &#96;\n      SELECT name FROM sqlite_master \n      WHERE type='table' AND name='ai_roles'\n    &#96;;\n    const tableExists = await db.query(checkTableSql);\n    \n    if (tableExists.length &gt; 0) {\n      console.log('✅ ai_roles 表已存在');\n      return;\n    }\n    \n    console.log('⚠️  ai_roles 表不存在，正在创建...');\n    \n    // 先创建表，然后创建索引\n    const createTableSql = &#96;\n      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ai_roles (\n        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n        name TEXT NOT NULL,\n        description TEXT NOT NULL,\n        avatar TEXT,\n        system_prompt TEXT,\n        dify_config TEXT NOT NULL,\n        enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\n        source TEXT,\n        created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n        updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n      )\n    &#96;;\n    \n    await db.query(createTableSql);\n    console.log('✅ ai_roles 表创建成功');\n    \n    // 创建索引\n    const indexes = [\n      'CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ai_roles_name ON ai_roles(name)',\n      'CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ai_roles_enabled ON ai_roles(enabled)',\n      'CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ai_roles_source ON ai_roles(source)',\n      'CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ai_roles_updated ON ai_roles(updated_at DESC)',\n    ];\n    \n    for (const indexSql of indexes) {\n      try {\n        await db.query(indexSql);\n      } catch (error: any) {\n        // 忽略索引已存在的错误\n        if (!error?.message?.includes('already exists') &amp;&amp; \n            !error?.message?.includes('duplicate')) {\n          console.warn(&#96;⚠️  创建索引失败（可能已存在）:&#96;, error?.message);\n        }\n      }\n    }\n    \n    // 创建触发器\n    const triggerSql = &#96;\n      CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS update_ai_roles_updated_at\n      AFTER UPDATE ON ai_roles\n      BEGIN\n        UPDATE ai_roles SET updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = NEW.id;\n      END\n    &#96;;\n}",

        "contents": "// ==================== 类型定义 ====================\n\n/**\n * AI角色数据库记录\n */\nexport interface AIRole {\n  id: string;\n  name: string;\n  description: string;\n  avatar?: string;\n  system_prompt?: string;\n  dify_config: string; // JSON字符串\n  enabled: number; // 0或1\n  source?: string;\n  created_at?: string;\n  updated_at?: string;\n}\n\n/**\n * Dify配置\n */\nexport interface DifyConfig {\n  apiUrl: string;\n;\n}",

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./backend/src/models/AIRole.ts",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 193
          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 647,
            "column": 1
          }
        },
        "contents": "export class AIRoleModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 初始化数据库表\n   */\n  async initializeTable(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n    await this.ensureConnection();\n    \n    // 直接执行CREATE TABLE语句（避免文件系统依赖）\n    const createTableSQL = &#96;\n      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ai_roles (\n        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n        name TEXT NOT NULL,\n        description TEXT NOT NULL,\n        avatar TEXT,\n        system_prompt TEXT,\n        dify_config TEXT NOT NULL,\n        enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\n        source TEXT,\n        created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n        updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n      );\n    &#96;;\n    \n    try {\n      await this.db.query(createTableSQL);\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      // 忽略\"表已存在\"等错误\n      if (!error.message?.includes('already exists') &amp;&amp; !error.message?.includes('duplicate')) {\n        console.warn('创建ai_roles表时出现警告:', error.message);\n      }\n    }\n    \n    // 创建索引\n    const indexes = [\n      'CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ai_roles_name ON ai_roles(name);',\n      'CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ai_roles_enabled ON ai_roles(enabled);',\n      'CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ai_roles_source ON ai_roles(source);',\n      'CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ai_roles_updated ON ai_roles(updated_at DESC);',\n    ];\n    \n    for (const indexSQL of indexes) {\n      try {\n        await this.db.query(indexSQL);\n      } catch (error: any) {\n        // 忽略索引已存在的错误\n        if (!error.message?.includes('already exists') &amp;&amp; !error.message?.includes('duplicate')) {\n          console.warn('创建索引时出现警告:', error.message);\n        }\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 创建AI角色\n   */\n  async create(data: CreateAIRoleDTO): Promise&lt;AIRoleConfig&gt; {\n    await this.ensureConnection();\n  }\n}",
        "signatures": {
          "ranges": [
            {
              "startPosition": {
                "line": 194,
                "column": 1
              },
              "endPosition": {
                "line": 194,
                "column": 8
              }

        "contents": "-- 头脑风暴群聊功能数据库表结构\n-- 用于存储多Agent协作讨论的会话、参与者和消息\n\n-- 1. 头脑风暴会话表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS brainstorm_sessions (\n    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n    title TEXT NOT NULL,\n    topic TEXT NOT NULL,\n    description TEXT,\n    creator_id TEXT,\n    project_id INTEGER, -- 关联的项目ID\n    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'active', 'completed', 'stopped')),\n    config TEXT, -- JSON格式存储配置（终止条件等）\n    summary TEXT, -- AI生成的讨论总结\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    completed_at DATETIME\n);\n\n-- 2. 参与者表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS brainstorm_participants (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    session_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n    ai_role_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n    display_name TEXT,\n    role_type TEXT, -- 角色类型（专家领域）\n    sort_order INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES brainstorm_sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE\n);\n\n-- 3. 讨论消息表\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS brainstorm_messages (\n    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n    session_id TEXT NOT NULL,\n    participant_id INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    round_number INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\n    content TEXT NOT NULL,\n    reply_to_id TEXT, -- 回复的消息ID（可选）\n    metadata TEXT, -- JSON格式存储元数据（token使用等）\n    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES brainstorm_sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (participant_id) REFERENCES brainstorm_participants(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    FOREIGN KEY (reply_to_id) REFERENCES brainstorm_messages(id) ON DELETE SET NULL\n);\n\n-- 创建索引以提高查询性能\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_brainstorm_sessions_status ON brainstorm_sessions(status);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_brainstorm_sessions_created_at ON brainstorm_sessions(created_at DESC);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_brainstorm_sessions_creator_id ON brainstorm_sessions(creator_id);",

        "contents": "export class PageToolConfigModel {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 初始化数据库表\n   */\n  async initializeTable(): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n    await this.ensureConnection();\n    \n    const dbType = this.db.getType();\n    \n    // 创建表\n    const createTableSQL = dbType === 'sqlite' ? &#96;\n      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS page_tool_configs (\n        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n        page_type TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n        page_title TEXT NOT NULL,\n        dialogue_title TEXT NOT NULL,\n        studio_title TEXT NOT NULL,\n        workflow_selection_key TEXT NOT NULL,\n        enabled_tool_ids TEXT,\n        feature_label_map TEXT,\n        is_active INTEGER DEFAULT 1,\n        created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n        updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n      );\n    &#96; : &#96;\n      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS page_tool_configs (\n        id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n        page_type TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n        page_title TEXT NOT NULL,\n        dialogue_title TEXT NOT NULL,\n        studio_title TEXT NOT NULL,\n        workflow_selection_key TEXT NOT NULL,\n        enabled_tool_ids TEXT,\n        feature_label_map TEXT,\n        is_active INTEGER DEFAULT 1,\n        created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n        updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n      );\n    &#96;;\n    \n    try {\n      await this.db.query(createTableSQL);\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      // 忽略\"表已存在\"等错误\n      if (!error.message?.includes('already exists') &amp;&amp; !error.message?.includes('duplicate')) {\n        console.warn('创建page_tool_configs表时出现警告:', error.message);\n      }\n    }\n    \n    // 创建索引\n    const indexes = [\n      'CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_page_tool_configs_page_type ON page_tool_configs(page_type);',\n      'CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_page_tool_configs_active ON page_tool_configs(is_active);',\n    ];\n    \n    for (const indexSQL of indexes)\n  }\n}",
